name: supply-checkout
description: Shared supply checkout sheets with barcode and receipt scanning, built as a claude.ai artifact and a static web bundle.

scripts.build: npm run build:artifact && npm run build:web && npm run build:demo
scripts.lint: eslint . && node scripts/check-links.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/validate-html.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:artifact && npm run test:web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run check:public && npm run check:regions && npm run test:scripts && npm test
scripts.test:coverage: COVERAGE=1 BUILD=artifact playwright test --project=desktop-chrome && COVERAGE=1 BUILD=web playwright test --project=desktop-chrome
scripts.test:scripts: shellcheck scripts/*.sh && bash scripts/land-pr.test.sh && bash scripts/beads-pr.test.sh && node --test scripts/publish-web.test.mjs scripts/ops.test.mjs scripts/check-stray-files.test.mjs scripts/backlog-page.test.mjs
scripts.publish:demo: npm run build:demo && node scripts/publish-web.mjs publish --channel demo --dir dist/demo
